name: @mark1russell7/grafana-infra
description: Docker Compose Grafana stack (Alloy, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, Grafana) with the lag dashboards

no-console.reason: The sources of grafana-infra had 0 console calls on 2026-11-25, and the count stays at 0. Each console call fails from 2027-01-20. Output for a person goes to the printer of @mark1russell7/text, and a diagnostic goes to a log record of @mark1russell7/otel-ts.

typed-scripts.reason: The 6 scripts of 2026-11-25 are JavaScript. The list only gets shorter, and a new JavaScript file fails. The end: a pull request that writes each script in TypeScript, with a tsconfig that the typecheck script examines.

shared-ci.off: ci.yml runs its own job site (types, tests and build of the site package) on 2026-11-25. The end: a pull request that moves ci.yml to reusable-ci.yml of the template, with the differences as its inputs.

playwright-install.reason: verify.yml installs Chromium with its own command on 2026-11-25. The end: verify.yml uses the action setup-playwright of the template, in the same pull request as the shared CI.
